description:
## Problem (reproduced)
`benchbox/core/tpcds/schema/table_specs.yaml` marks only one column as primary key on six fact tables and none on `inventory`. Each column row is `[name, type, size, nullable, primary_key, fk]`; for example `ss_item_sk` is false around line 1628 and `ss_ticket_number` true around line 1677. The generated DDL is `PRIMARY KEY(ss_ticket_number)`.

DuckDB TPC-DS `tuned` and `auto` fail: all six fact tables hit `PRIMARY KEY or UNIQUE constraint violation: duplicate key "1"` and the run halts. Enforcing engines (Postgres family, SQLite, MotherDuck, DuckLake) would fail the same way. On optimizer-trusted informational keys (Redshift; Snowflake/Databricks with RELY), a wrong key risks silently wrong results.

## Change
Set the spec composite keys, in spec order:
- `store_sales (ss_item_sk, ss_ticket_number)`;
- `store_returns (sr_item_sk, sr_ticket_number)`;
- `catalog_sales (cs_item_sk, cs_order_number)`;
- `catalog_returns (cr_item_sk, cr_order_number)`;
- `web_sales (ws_item_sk, ws_order_number)`;
- `web_returns (wr_item_sk, wr_order_number)`;
- `inventory (inv_date_sk, inv_item_sk, inv_warehouse_sk)`.

Confirm the DDL emits PK columns in spec order, not table column position.

## Audit (record results in capability-registry notes)
- **Known:** BigQuery emits `PRIMARY KEY (…) NOT ENFORCED` (`bigquery.py:2146,2157,2196`). There is no `RELY` in `snowflake.py` or `databricks/adapter.py`.
- **Remaining:** whether the Redshift planner exploits informational keys for the TPC-DS queries.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- Untuned (`notuning`) runs are unaffected.
- Note in release notes that tuned/auto TPC-DS results before and after this change are not comparable.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow (`make worktree-claim BRANCH=...`, `make agent-write-preflight`).
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`.
- Then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`.
- No live cloud runs without explicit user approval stating the command, maximum runtime, log path and stop condition.
- Re-read every file:line anchor before editing. Anchors are from develop d39166ea.
